notes: Path return, not allow/block: a command hook prints the path as the last non-empty line of stdout, redirecting any other hook output to stderr; an HTTP hook returns hookSpecificOutput.worktreePath. Hook failure or missing path fails creation. Runs for claude --worktree, the EnterWorktree tool, a subagent with isolation: worktree, a workflow agent in its own worktree, a background session, and claude remote-control in worktree mode; it does not run when Claude executes git worktree add through the Bash tool (use a PreToolUse hook with the Bash matcher for that).
